title: Wildwood
overview: Prue and her classmate Curtis are drawn into a magical forest filled with enchanted creatures, loyal allies, and formidable adversaries as they embark on a desperate quest to rescue Prue's abducted baby brother from a murder of crows led by a mysterious woman named Alexandra.

title: Violent Night 2
overview: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

title: Three Timing
overview: In Three Timing, after making a wish for love, Yên (Thúy Ngân) is stunned when all three of her exes—Tùng (Steven Nguyễn), Phong (Ngô Kiến Huy), and Minh (Otis)—suddenly try to win her back. Faced with three men offering three very different kinds of love, Yên decides to give all of them a chance at once. But as overlapping dates and buried secrets threaten to unravel, will she find true love—or end up in a romantic mess she’ll never forget?

title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
overview: A star rises over Bethlehem as Christ is born. But when Herod orders the slaughter of the innocents, Mary and Joseph must protect the child promised to save the world.

title: North
overview: Young Gerda sets off into the great unknown in search of her friend Kai, who has mysteriously vanished.

title: The Golden Snowflake Heist
overview: On Christmas Eve, a powerful jewelry tycoon and his family attend an exclusive auction aboard a luxurious yacht, hoping to reclaim the Golden Snowflake, a priceless family heirloom that has been lost for years.  However, the glamorous evening takes a dangerous turn when a gang of robbers storms the yacht, seizes control, and seals off every escape route. What was meant to be a perfect festive celebration quickly descends into a high-stakes fight for survival.  Will the precious heirloom find its way back to its rightful owners?

title: Avengers: Doomsday
overview: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

title: Dune: Part Three
overview: Nearly two decades after he seized control of the Imperium, Paul Atreides is now a ruthless Emperor, and must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

title: Jumanji: Open World
overview: Our heroes have escaped the ever-changing jungles of Jumanji before, but this time the game comes to us—as Jumanji breaks free of its console, unleashing its chaos into our world.

title: Bloodline: The Curse Within
overview: When modern medicine surrenders to an ancient curse, a renowned pediatric cardiac surgeon is forced to use the very scalpel that once saved lives to dissect the sins of his own past in a desperate fight to save his daughter from possession by a vengeful spirit born of a buried history.
